tracks.subject: a retired salaryman alone at the kotatsu over one winter weekend, timing himself on a stopwatch to finish the 1000-piece Mount Fuji jigsaw his grandson did in nine hours at New Year, sorting edge pieces into a biscuit tin and losing an hour to a sky made of nothing but blue
